comments.author: _HAVOC_
comments.body_html:
Guys, SPT isn’t being shut down.

BSG only pointed out a trademark infringement regarding the name “TARKOV”— NOT SPT itself (i.e., the game itself).

  1. The current dev team is simply stepping back to avoid potential legal trouble. this site here will be closed.

  2. You can keep playing an already installed version of “SPT.” Everything is open source, and a new dev team—or quite possibly the same one, just under a different name—will likely continue the project. It might not be called SingleplayerTarkov anymore; maybe SingleplayerTarkooov… Who knows…

  3. It looks like all the mods have been archived here and are available for download: https://forge-alt.katrinfoxvr.com/

This site will likely become our new home.

And a request from me to the modder Hysocs: PLEASE release a version for 4.0.13. That’s the version most players will be using for the next few months (or a year). It takes a long time for the best mods to get updated to 4.10, and nobody plays a fresh 4.10 version without mods…
